howP.en: The formula is plain Ohm's law along the loop: three-phase drop is √3·I·L·ρ/S, single-phase is 2·I·L·ρ/S (the factor 2 walks out and back). The ρ of copper at working temperature is about 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m, aluminium 0.028 — aluminum needs a section 60% larger for the same drop, which is why long aluminium runs keep disappointing. The 5% ceiling comes from distribution-code practice: keep the feeder under 5% and motors still start; past 8–10%, contactors chatter and VFDs trip on undervoltage long before anything burns.
howP.zh: 公式就是欧姆定律沿线走一圈：三相压降 √3·I·L·ρ/S，单相 2·I·L·ρ/S（系数 2 是来回两根线）。铜在工作温度下的电阻率约 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m，铝约 0.028——同样的压降铝芯要放大 60% 截面，这就是长距离铝线总让人失望的原因。5% 这条线来自配电规范惯例：馈线压住 5%，电机还能正常启动；过了 8–10%，接触器吸不牢、变频器欠压跳停，什么都还没烧，设备先罢工。

a.en: It is the working consensus: distribution codes allow voltage deviation around ±5–7% at the utilization point, and 5% is the design ceiling that keeps you inside it with margin. Sensitive loads (VFDs, servers) deserve 3%. This page flags anything over 5%, but your local code wins.
a.zh: 5% 是工程共识：配电规范允许用电端电压偏差 ±5–7%，设计上把线路压降控制在 5% 以内才有余量。变频器、服务器这类敏感负载建议按 3% 卡。本页按 5% 判定，但当地规范说了算。

q.en: The % drop passes — am I done?

a.en: No. Voltage drop is one of three gates. Ampacity (current the cable survives continuously), and short-circuit withstand / breaker coordination come first. A 1.5 mm² cable can pass the 5% test on a short run and still be illegal for a 20 A circuit.
a.zh: 没有。压降只是三关之一。载流量（电缆长期吃得下多少电流）和短路耐受/保护配合排在它前面。1.5 mm² 的线短距离压降能过，但 20A 回路用它是违规的。

q.en: Why does copper beat aluminium by 60%?
q.zh: 为什么铜比铝能省 60% 截面？

a.en: Resistivity: 0.0175 vs 0.028 Ω·mm²/m. For the same drop, S must scale with ρ, so aluminium needs about 1.6× the section. Aluminium is still worth it on big feeders because it is 3–4× cheaper per kg and much lighter — the ampacity per yuan wins on long runs.
a.zh: 电阻率的差别：0.0175 对 0.028。同样压降下截面正比于 ρ，铝要 1.6 倍。但大长度馈线上铝依然划算——每公斤便宜三四倍还轻得多，按「每元载流量」算长线是铝的天下。

q.en: Should I use the next size up from the minimum?
q.zh: 比最小线径再放大一档吗？

a.en: Usually yes, for three quiet reasons: conductor derating in conduit bundles, future load growth, and motor starting current (6–8× rated) which spikes the drop momentarily. The minimum passes the steady-state exam; the next size up passes the real one.
a.zh: 通常要，理由有三个都不响亮：穿管多根要降容、负载会加、电机启动电流是额定的 6–8 倍，瞬间压降会翻倍。最小线径过的是稳态考试，放大一档过的才是现场。

note.en: One-time. Unlocks ampacity check and multi-load runs.
note.zh: 一次性买断。解锁载流量校验和多负载线路。
